body:
## Problem

`POST /api/login` always fails against a current Claude Code CLI. The login flow starts, the CLI prints its authorization URL, and the router discards it — then times out reporting that no URL ever appeared.

Reproduced on `main` (`fa90d37`, v0.28.0), image built from the `with-claude-cli` stage:

```json
{"error":{"message":"no authorization URL appeared: timed out; last output: ow to sign in (c to copy)\n\nhttps://claude.com/cai/oauth/authorize?code=true&client_id=9d1c250a-…&response_type=code&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fplatform.claude.com%2Foauth%2Fcode%2Fcallback&scope=user%3Ainference&code_challenge=…&code_challenge_method=S256&state=…\n\n\nPastecodehereifprompted>","type":"api_error"},"type":"error"}
HTTP=502
```

The error message contains the URL it says never appeared. The PTY capture works; the recognition step is what fails.

## Cause

`src/login_url.rs`:

```rust
/// Hosts an authorization URL is accepted from.
const AUTH_HOSTS: &[&str] = &["claude.ai", "anthropic.com"];
```

The CLI now prints the URL on **`claude.com`** — a host absent from that list, and not a subdomain of either entry, so `extract_login_url` rejects it:

```
host in URL : claude.com
AUTH_HOSTS  : ["claude.ai", "anthropic.com"]
match       : False
```

The redirect target in the same URL (`platform.claude.com`) is on that domain too, which suggests `claude.com` is where this flow now lives rather than a one-off.

Every unit test in the module uses `https://claude.ai/oauth/authorize?…`, so the suite passes while the real CLI cannot be recognised — the tests encode the old host rather than the CLI's current behaviour.

## Fix

Add the host:

```rust
const AUTH_HOSTS: &[&str] = &["claude.ai", "claude.com", "anthropic.com"];
```

The host list is provably the reason the URL is rejected: the printed host is `claude.com`, which matches neither entry nor is a subdomain of one, so `extract_login_url` returns `None` and the flow can only time out. (I am re-running the full login against a rebuilt image with this line changed; I will follow up here with the result rather than leave the claim untested.)

Two suggestions beyond the immediate fix:

- **cover `claude.com` in the tests**, so the host list cannot silently fall behind the CLI again;
- consider whether an unrecognised-but-present URL deserves a distinct error. "No authorization URL appeared" sent while quoting the URL is a confusing diagnostic — something like "found a URL on an unrecognised host: <host>" would point straight at the cause.

## Note on the excerpt text

Unrelated to the failure, but visible in the output above: `Paste code here if prompted>` arrives as `Pastecodehereifprompted>`. `unwrap_terminal_lines` joins any line whose length equals the terminal width, which drops the padding spaces that separated the words. Harmless for URL extraction (URLs contain no spaces), but it makes excerpts shown to humans hard to read.
title: POST /api/login never recognises the CLI's authorization URL: AUTH_HOSTS is missing claude.com
